artworks.title: Un peintre fantaisiste
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a black and white illustration showing two figures in an art gallery. One figure is wearing a tall hat and gesturing animatedly, while the other is pointing at a painting on the wall. The drawing depicts a moment of dialogue or critique between the two individuals. The text at the top and bottom of the image indicates a satirical take on art viewership, in the style of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Ah! Mon cher monsieur, permettez de  ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men facing each other. The man on the left has exaggerated facial features and curly hair under a tall top hat. He is wearing a dark jacket with a turned-down collar. The man on the right also has exaggerated features with curly hair under a smaller hat. He is wearing lighter-colored clothing and is clasping the other man's hands. Several other men in similar hats and coats are in the background of a crowded indoor space with framed pictures and other people milling around.

artworks.title: Quelle société abatarde et corrompue ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of art patrons in a gallery. The drawing shows a group of individuals in a gallery or exhibition setting, gazing upon artworks displayed on the walls. The drawing is rendered in black and white, with strong lines and defined shading. The figures are exaggerated, with elongated facial features and an expressive demeanor. The central figure gesticulates towards a painting. This piece captures the atmosphere of 19th-century art salons, where art and society were often critiqued. The text at the bottom suggests a commentary on societal preferences in art. This is in style of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Votre client est un  gredin ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two men interacting. The man on the left is seated at a table, looking slightly surprised towards the other man. He has short hair, prominent sideburns, and a receding hairline. He wears a black robe with a white cravat, with food, utensils, and a bottle on the table. The man on the right stands, holding a bottle, wearing a tall hat and a robe. The background shows a wooden panel wall, a window with a curtain, and a geometric object on the wall. Text in the upper portion indicates it is part of a publication.

artworks.title: Chut ... ! Ma fille est en communication ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two men in a room facing each other. The man on the left appears to be speaking, with his mouth slightly open, turned towards the other man. He has round glasses and curly hair, and is dressed in a dark tailcoat. The man on the right is leaning forward, holding his hat, with a grin on his face. He has a prominent chin and a receding hairline, dressed similarly. Behind them, a woman is seated at a table. A few other figures are in the background, with framed pictures on the walls and a textured floor. The setting seems to be an indoor space.

artworks.title: Ca mord, quelle chance! Je vous défends ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of fishermen in a comical scene. The image shows several men fishing by a body of water, each in different poses. Two figures in the foreground are focused on their fishing lines, one sitting and watching intently, while the other stands with a slightly scrunched posture. Behind them, more figures are fishing. The background includes a cloud-filled sky, creating an outdoor setting. The image uses exaggerated facial expressions and poses for humor. The text and publishing details suggest it was printed in a French publication.

artworks.title: La rèforme électorale en angleterre
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of individuals in a dramatic scene involving a door. The image depicts figures with exaggerated expressions, two of whom are pushing against a door, as a third figure advises them to open it. Inside, a shadowy figure seems to be exerting pressure on the door from the other side. Visible in the room are chairs and possibly a table. The illustration employs strong lines and shading to accentuate expressions and physical exertion.

artworks.title: Et ces deux grands débris se consolaient
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men embracing each other in a hug. The man on the left has short dark hair, while the man on the right is bald. They are both wearing dark overcoats, with a small tear visible on the coat of the man on the right. In the background, there is a large poster with the word "LA LIBERTE" at the top and some illegible text below. The setting appears to be indoors, with visible walls and the back of a chair on the left side. The image is presented in a black-and-white sketch style.

artworks.title: J'ai eu beau le bercer ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: In the image, a woman is seated in a chair. Her eyes are closed as her head tilts back. She has exaggerated facial features, a large nose, and pronounced cheeks, with styled hair. She wears a voluminous gown with intricate designs and the word "DIPLOMATIE." A skeletal creature stands beside her on a large bassinet, wearing a cap with a plume and holding a sword. The background shows draped curtains.

artworks.title: Les chasses ... ne se ressemblent pas
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This image depicts two individuals in different outfits. One person is dressed in traditional hunter's attire, while the other is wearing a whimsical, antiquated costume resembling a medieval character. The setting appears to be satirical or humorous, with a modern-day hunter standing confidently next to a character in a dramatic outfit. The character in the antiquated costume is holding a spear or staff. The drawing shows a playful contrast between the two characters in their attire and demeanor, emphasizing the absurdity of their encounter.

artworks.title: Hi! hi! ... Il m'a léché le beurre de ma tartine
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two cartoonish figures in a satirical setting. The first figure is labeled as part of the "Confédération Germanique" and appears as a small, troll-like character wearing a loose garment, standing with a distressed expression and pointing. The second figure is much larger, seated in a chair, wearing a spiked helmet, and has a stern, defiant demeanor. The image is executed in a detailed, linear style typical of political caricatures of the 19th century. The phrase below the image adds another layer of satirical commentary.

artworks.title: Un divertissement de pékin
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three individuals playing a game similar to dominoes in a decorative room. The people are focused on playing with domino-like tiles on a table, with one person looking at their hand, one observing, and another standing behind the table. The room has detailed archways and walls. Items on the table include a glass, plate, and candle. The figures have exaggerated physical characteristics but the scene conveys a sense of strategic engagement and social interaction.

artworks.title: Eh bien Malin! comment le trouvez vous celui-la!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: In the image, two men are seated at a small, round table. The man on the left has unkempt, short hair and is wearing a dark suit jacket over a white shirt, facing slightly towards the viewer. The man on the right has a balding head with short hair on the sides, wearing a similar dark suit, facing the other man. Both men appear to be engaged in a conversation at a table set with wine bottles and glasses. A hat is hanging on the wall behind them, and there are abstract shapes on the background wall, suggesting an indoor setting such as a restaurant or dining area.

artworks.title: Tiens vous v'la, què que vous avez donc la
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two women captured from the waist up, engaged in conversation. The woman on the left is slightly hunched, facing the woman on the right. She has curly hair visible under her bonnet. The woman on the right stands upright, facing left towards the other woman. Both women are in a busy street with a crowd in the background, including figures wearing top hats and other bonnets. The backdrop features sketchy outlines of buildings.

artworks.title: La cour rend des services et non pas des arrêts!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three men in a stone room. The scene shows two men standing and one man lying down. One standing man is dressed in a military-style uniform with a large plumage hat and an ornate cape slung over his shoulders. The other standing figure, on the left, is wearing a suit appropriate for a more contemporary 19th-century style, with a bow tie and a waistcoat. The third man in the background is lying on a bed or a bench, dressed similarly in a contemporary style. The man is resting his head on his hand. There is a large earthenware jug on the floor. The style is characterized by detailed cross-hatching and fine lines typical of a lithograph print from the 19th century.

artworks.title: Le vol au renfoncement
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three individuals in a scene. The central figure is adjusting a cap, with a determined expression. The other two individuals are engaging with the central figure, one with a confrontational gesture and the other seeming to explain. The scene is depicted in black and white, with shading for depth and texture in the clothing and on the cobblestone ground.

artworks.title: Bertrand, j'adore l'industrie...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two animated characters interacting. The character on the left is standing with a broad-legged stance, pointing forward with a stick-like object. This character has exaggerated facial features, including a beard and nose, wearing a cap, a loose shirt tucked into high-waisted pants, and holding a mallet. The character on the right is standing, holding an umbrella, with exaggerated facial features, including a long, pointed nose and a comical expression. They are wearing a long coat, buttoned down the front, and a tall, curved hat. The background includes part of a stylized structure, possibly framing a satirical or comedic scene.

artworks.title: Robert Macaire banquier et juré
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men shaking hands. The man on the left stands upright with his left hand raised, wearing a cap and long coat with visible buttons and epaulets. His facial features include a prominent nose and elongated chin, and he has sideburns. He wears knee-high boots and has a monocle on his left eye, connected by a cord. The man on the right leans back slightly, with a rotund frame and curved posture. He has a bushy hairstyle and a mustache, and a neutral expression. He wears a long overcoat, a layered suit with a bowtie, and buckle shoes. He holds the other man's hand in the handshake. The background features a patterned wall with a window or grid design displaying the word "CAISSE," and the setting appears to be indoors with a flat floor.

artworks.title: Une mine d'or qui dort
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration showing two men in a full-body view. The man on the left is standing upright, facing slightly left, with his arms at his sides, while the man on the right is facing him with an animated posture, with his right hand open and gesturing. The man on the left has a long, narrow face with a prominent nose and chin and short or tucked under a tall top hat. He wears a long coat with a high collar and tails, narrow trousers, and holds something in his left hand. The man on the right has a square-shaped face with sideburns and bushy brows. He wears a shorter hat, a cape over his shoulders, and a patterned scarf around his neck. Both men wear shoes with pointed toes. In the background, there is a simple landscape with hills and a small windmill-like structure to the left. The drawing is set on a lightly text-filled background printed beneath the illustration.

artworks.title: Votre visite a été bien courte ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing outdoors. The person on the left is leaning against a railing with their hands clasped together, slightly hunched over. They have a wrinkled face and short, curly hair, and are wearing a long, vertically-striped dress. The person on the right is standing and leaning on a cane with a slight bent posture. They are smiling and raising a top hat with their right hand. This individual has distinct facial features with a prominent chin and is wearing a long dress with a wide belt or band at the waist, a shawl over their shoulders, and a bonnet on their head. The background features a textured wall and a portion of a fence or railing behind the person on the left.

artworks.title: La voyez-vous la comète? ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures observing the night sky. The piece depicts an interaction between the figures, with one pointing towards a cluster of stars. Set against a backdrop of indistinct urban structures, the drawing is composed in shades of grey. The characters are dressed in 19th-century attire, one with a top hat and the other with a cap. The text at the top mentions "La Comète de 1857."

artworks.title: Croyant l'apercevoir ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a side profile of two individuals in bed. The person sitting upright wears a nightcap, has a long nose and a slightly prominent chin. The other individual wears a nightcap and their face is partially obscured by bedding. Both are covered by a blanket in a bed with draped fabric. The room is dimly lit by a window on the left, revealing a dark textured night sky. The scene is framed by drapery, creating an intimate bedtime setting.

artworks.title: La parisiens dans l'attente de la ...comète
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: Three individuals are shown standing, looking up toward the sky. The person on the left is leaning back slightly, holding an umbrella under their arm, with their mouth open. They are wearing a long coat and a tall hat. The middle individual stands with an open mouth, in a voluminous dress, a scarf around the neck, and a wide-brimmed bonnet. The person on the right is standing some distance behind the first two, looking upwards, wearing similar clothing to the person on the left, with a tall hat and a long coat, with hands in pockets. The background has outlines of buildings, suggesting a city setting. The ground is lightly detailed and there are small dots in the sky.

artworks.title: Illustration
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of E. Gerald Lamboley, 1993)
artworks.description: The image features a sketched scene with three individuals. Two are seated in armchairs, while one stands to the right. The seated man is in full view, wearing a suit with a dark jacket, waistcoat, bowtie, and light trousers. Beside him, a woman wearing a high-collared dress with long sleeves and a shawl is partially visible. The standing woman, seen in profile, has her hair styled in an updo and is dressed in a long, high-necked blouse with stripes and a long skirt with a belt. She rests her hand on the back of the seated man's chair. The background consists of simple sketched outlines, with an additional small head sketch at the bottom edge of the image.
